description: ACTGOV FLOOD DEPTH MODEL is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). Along with other jurisdictions in Australia, the ACT is moving toward national best practice in flood risk management. This is the most complete review of Canberra’s catchments and their associated flood risk to date. A 1% Annual Exceedance Probability (AEP) flood is a flood which has a 1% chance of occurring in any year. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). Its tags are 1_, actmapi, aep, depth, emergency-management. It offers 2 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, html. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
